gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.familie.uitleg: The four animals of this sign: their names, how they feel, call them back or let them hide.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.verblijf.uitleg: How big the enclosure is (the animals stay inside), show its edge and where they sleep at night.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.tevreden.uitleg: How happy the family is and what they still want. Hover over a line for help.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.cadeautjes.uitleg: Happy animals sometimes leave a gift. Collect them here.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.info.uitleg: A fact about this animal, your best photo and when you may buy a sign of this species again.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.bouw.uitleg: Let the family build something: they look at the terrain themselves and build something that fits.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tab.bezorgen.uitleg: The stork brings parcels to a friend's stork mailbox.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.niet_jouw: This sign belongs to %s: you may only look.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.al_klus: This sign already has a job: %s. Stop it first (Build Job tab, Stop). A sign does one job at a time.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.al_voorstel: There is a proposal already: %s. Approve or cancel it first (Happiness tab).
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_slaapplek: No sleeping spot has been chosen yet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_cadeaus: No gifts yet. Happy animals (60% or more) leave one now and then.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_vrienden: Nobody else has placed a stork mailbox yet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_bestemming: First choose who the parcel is for.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.geen_spook: This job has no ghost (the animals only carry or deliver): there is nothing to move.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.bouwt_al: The ghost is already being built. Pause it first in the ghost panel.
gui.guhs.verblijf.hernoem.veld.uitleg: Type a name (empty = no name). Then click Name.
gui.guhs.verblijf.hernoem.uitleg: Gives this animal the name from the box. You see it above its head.
gui.guhs.verblijf.terugroepen.uitleg: All animals come straight back to the sign, also when they are hiding.
gui.guhs.verblijf.verstoppen.uitleg: The animals hide for 20 seconds (handy when you want to build). Then they come back by themselves, or earlier with Call back.
gui.guhs.verblijf.vorm.uitleg: Switch between a round and a rectangular enclosure.
gui.guhs.verblijf.schuif.uitleg: Drag to make the enclosure bigger or smaller. You see the new edge straight away.
gui.guhs.verblijf.rand.uitleg: Shows the enclosure's edge with pink dust on the ground (2 minutes, or until you hide it). The animals stay inside that edge.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.wijs.uitleg: The menu closes. Walk to the spot and right-click a block inside the enclosure: that is where the animals sleep at night. Click the sign to stop.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.wijs.begin: Right-click a block inside the enclosure: that is where they sleep at night. (Click the sign to stop; you have 2 minutes.)
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.wijs.gestopt: Stopped pointing at a sleeping spot.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.gezet: Sleeping spot chosen at %s. Sleep well!
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.te_ver: That spot is outside the enclosure. Choose a block inside the edge.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.weghalen.uit: Without a sleeping spot the animals sleep wherever they are.
gui.guhs.verblijf.thuisplek.geen: No sleeping spot yet: they sleep where they are.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tevreden.hover: Hover over a line to see how to tick it.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.water: Have at least %s blocks of water inside the edge (dig, then pour a bucket of water in).
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.blokken: Put at least %s of these blocks inside the edge: %s.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.waar: Everything inside the edge counts, from 6 blocks below to 10 above the sign.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.ruimte: Make the enclosure bigger: a radius of at least 12, or a rectangle of at least 8 by 8 (Enclosure tab).
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.geaaid: Pet one of the animals today: right-click with an empty hand.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.speeltje: Put a %s within 8 blocks inside the enclosure. Sold in the safari gift shop (Animal toys), or craft it.
gui.guhs.verblijf.tip.vrienden: Place an enclosure sign of a friend within 24 blocks of this sign: %s.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voer.traktatie: Treats (feeding is optional: they feed themselves): %s. A treat gives hearts.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.verblijf.uitleg: Puts a proposal down as a ghost: an enclosure with everything this animal loves, with a fence around it. Nothing is built yet. Like it? Choose Approved: the animals build it themselves, with your blocks (from your inventory and the linked Bank Guh).
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.klaar: There is the proposal (the ghost). Look around and choose Approved or Cancel in the sign.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.uitleg: The proposal stands there as a ghost. Like it? Choose Approved: the animals walk over and build it with your blocks. If something is missing, they build what is there and the rest stays a ghost.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.annuleren.uit: Removes the proposal. Nothing was built or paid yet.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.goed.uitleg: The family goes on a work outing and builds the enclosure themselves, block by block. The blocks come from your inventory and the linked Bank Guh.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.tekort: Not everything is there yet (the rest stays a ghost until you have it): %s
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.gaan: Work outing! The %s family is going to build the enclosure.
gui.guhs.verblijf.cadeautjes.pak.uitleg: All gifts go to your inventory (full? then they drop on the ground).
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.kies.uitleg: Click to choose the next friend with a stork mailbox.
gui.guhs.verblijf.bezorgen.stuur.uitleg: The stork takes the items from a chest next to the sign and flies to your friend's stork mailbox.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.variant.uitleg: Click for the next variant of this job.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.zoek.uitleg: The family looks for a good spot themselves (within 48 blocks of the sign) and puts the job down as a ghost. You can still move it after.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.wijs.uitleg: The menu closes. Then click with a shape wand on the block (or the 2 blocks) where the job should go, within 48 blocks of the sign. You have 2 minutes.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.bedien.uitleg: Opens the ghost panel: move, turn, build or pause.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.stop.uitleg: Stops the job: the ghost goes (what is built stays) and the family comes home.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.bank.uitleg: Click the sign with a Bank Key to link a Bank Guh: the family then also takes their blocks from the bank.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.buiten: Careful: part of the building (%s blocks, red) is outside the shed's reach (%s blocks). That part is not built.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.buiten.klaar: Part of the building (%s blocks) is outside the shed's reach (%s blocks): it stays a ghost.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.tip: Tip: a higher shed level has a bigger reach. Or move the ghost closer to the shed.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.tip.volgend: Tip: move it closer to the shed, or upgrade the shed: the next level builds up to %s blocks away.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.bereik.tip.max: Tip: move it closer to the shed.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.0: Shape wand and brushes, shapes up to 16, roofs, own blueprints up to 16, the library. Builds up to 64 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.1: Builder guhs, shapes up to 24, wireless material from every chest on the vadsnet. Builds up to 96 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.2: Nature shapes, the leveller, block text, blueprints up to 32. Builds up to 128 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.3: Paint machine, tunnel drill, publishing in the library. Builds up to 160 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.4: Shapes and blueprints up to 64, and Poof! Builds up to 192 blocks away
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.nodig.hover: Hover over a block for its name.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.lijstje.uitleg: Export to a list: you get a book with every block that is still missing (name and count). Handy at the crafting table.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.lijstje.niets.uitleg: Nothing is missing (in creative it builds for free).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.lijstje.gegeven: The shopping list is in your inventory.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.raster.uitleg: Click a tile. Grey = still locked (hover to see why).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.raster.knop: Click: choose from all options. Shift-click: one back.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bouw.uitleg: Let the shed build the ghost. If something is missing, it first asks whether to build anyway (what's missing stays a ghost).
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.pauze.uitleg: Pauses the building. Build! goes on.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niet_jouw.uitleg: This is not your shed: only the owner may build.
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.alles_er: All blocks are there! (from your inventory and the linked Bank Guh)
gui.guhs.verblijf.voorstel.lijstje.uitle: Gives you a booklet with every block still missing for this proposal: the exact name and how many. Handy next to the crafting table.
gui.guhs.verblijf.reden.niets_nodig: Nothing is missing: all blocks are there.
